### Connecting to miami policies
```{r policies_scraping}
robotstxt::paths_allowed(paths = "/policy-library/students/undergraduate/academic-regulations/", domain = "miamioh.edu", bot = '*')

policy_url = "https://miamioh.edu/policy-library/students/undergraduate/academic-regulations/"

policy = rvest::read_html(policy_url)
policy |> rvest::html_elements("a.news-lockup__body-link") -> links
length(links)
links |> rvest::html_attr("href") -> policy_sites

list = (policy_sites)
typeof(list)
```


### Scraping swim team website
```{r swim_scrape}
robotstxt::paths_allowed(paths = "/sports/swimming-and-diving/roster#women", domain = "miamiredhawks.com", bot = "*")

swim_url = "https://miamiredhawks.com/sports/swimming-and-diving/roster#women"

swim = rvest::read_html(swim_url)

section <- swim |> rvest::html_element("")

swim |> rvest::html_elements("a h3") |> rvest::html_text2() -> swim_names

swim |> rvest::html_elements("div span.items-center") |> rvest::html_text2() -> swim_locations

swim_names
swim_locations

df = data.frame(
  Name = swim_names,
  Location = swim_locations
)
```
